title: Evaluate language shim demand and define MVP adapter scope
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Background: We continue to receive a steady stream of requests asking for official client adapters (language shims) and guidance for streaming authentication patterns. Requests range from simple convenience wrappers to opinionated connection managers that abstract token rotation, backoff, and partial response streaming semantics. This ticket's goal is to systematically evaluate demand, synthesize signal across customers and internal intake, and produce a small, pragmatic MVP definition for one or two adapters plus a recommended auth ergonomics pattern doc.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A prioritization rubric that scores adapter requests against agreed signals and is approved by PM + Eng.
2) A decision memo that selects the MVP adapter languages and lists explicitly scoped features (no more than 6 features per adapter).
3) A proposed auth streaming pattern (token rotation + resumable streams) with examples for Node and Python.
4) A stakeholder signoff and a follow-up implementation ticket template for eng and design.
proposed_mvp_features: Open-source, minimal wrapper: installable package with typed request/response helpers
Streaming helper: client-side small buffer, easy hook for partial messages and reconnect semantics
Auth helper: token provider interface + reference implemention for short-lived tokens and rotation
Connection manager with retry/backoff and automatic model fallback hook
Simple telemetry hooks (usage counter, latency histogram) with opt-out flag
One end-to-end example app (chat + streaming) with README and quickstart
prioritization_matrix: Signals considered: number of customer requests, revenue-weighted customer count, internal support tickets, complexity estimate (eng effort), security/compliance friction, community ecosystem gap. Score range 0-5 per signal. Tiebreakers: enterprise contracts (higher weight), presence of existing community libs, overlapping SDK initiatives. Example scoring: Python: 5, Node: 4, Java: 2, Go: 1, Ruby: 0.5. Streaming-specific weight added if >30% requests mention streaming ergonomics.
tasks: Gather and normalize intake: compile SDK/client requests from support, sales, and public repos (owner: PM)
Run quick interviews with top 6 customers who requested adapters (owner: Solutions Eng)
Estimate engineering effort for candidate adapters (owner: Eng lead)
Draft prioritization rubric and run workshop with stakeholders (owner: PM)
Produce decision memo and proposed feature list for MVP (owner: PM)
Create follow-up implementation tickets: eng backlog + design spec + release checklist
